name: TechBucket
tagline: A Nepal-based company delivering hospital software and IT infrastructure products since 2019.

hero.title: Technology That Moves Your Business Forward
hero.subtitle: We build hospital management software for healthcare providers, and supply genuine IT infrastructure products to every industry across Nepal — from education, finance and hospitality to manufacturing and retail. Trusted by organisations across the Kathmandu Valley and beyond.

about.title: Hospital Software, Infrastructure for Everyone
paragraphs: TechBucket Pvt. Ltd. is a Nepal-based software and IT company. We design, build, and maintain hospital management software that improves patient outcomes and streamlines clinical workflows — and we supply genuine IT hardware products to organisations in every industry.

Founded in 2019, we started in healthcare IT and grew into infrastructure — providing hospitals with purpose-built software and supplying servers, networking, storage and power protection across Nepal.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To democratise healthcare technology in Nepal by delivering affordable, scalable and reliable digital solutions that empower healthcare providers to focus on what matters most — patient care. We believe every clinic, from Kathmandu to the remote hills, deserves world-class software.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To be the most trusted healthcare technology partner in South Asia — building a future where every healthcare worker has access to digital tools that are as powerful as they are intuitive, enabling Nepal's healthcare system to reach its full potential.

values.title: Innovation
values.body: We push the boundaries of healthcare technology with creative solutions that solve real-world clinical challenges.

values.title: Reliability
values.body: Healthcare never sleeps. Our systems are built for 99.9% uptime with rock-solid infrastructure and redundancy.

values.title: Compassion
values.body: Every line of code we write is in service of better patient outcomes and a healthier Nepal.

contact.heading: Let's Build Something Great Together
contact.subheading: Looking to build better software for your healthcare organisation or need IT infrastructure products? Write to us and our team will respond within 24 hours.

footer.blurb: Hospital software and IT infrastructure products for Nepal since 2019.
